welcome.title: Welcome to Orxis
welcome.description: Orxis helps you build a complete AI assistant profile in minutes — no account needed, totally free. Just answer a few questions and copy the result into Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude.
welcome.tip: You can skip any step you want — every field is optional.

step1.title: Step 1 — Pick Your Direction
step1.description: Start by describing what you need your AI assistant for — or tap a category like "Content Creation" or "Business" to get domain-specific suggestions throughout the wizard.
step1.tip: Choosing a category pre-fills relevant presets, but you can always type your own.

step23.title: Step 2 & 3 — Persona & Task
step23.description: Choose the AI's expert role (like "Scriptwriter" or "Business Analyst") and what you want it to do (like "Script Writing" or "Market Analysis"). The presets adapt to your chosen domain.
step23.tip: Click "Show all presets" to see options from every domain.

step4.title: Step 4 — Your Context
step4.description: Tell the AI about your channel, company, or project. This makes the generated assistant way more tailored — but it's totally optional if you want a general-purpose one.
step4.tip: Try "Fill with example" to see what kind of details work best.

step7.title: Step 7 — Shortcuts
step7.description: Create reusable prompt templates with {{variables}} you fill in each time. For example: "Generate {{count}} video ideas about {{topic}}". These are included in your final output.
step7.tip: Click "✨ Suggest for me" to get domain-specific templates instantly.

output.title: Your Output — Ready to Paste
output.description: After generating, you'll get a complete AI assistant profile with a name, description, full instructions, conversation starters, and shortcuts. Use the platform tabs (Gems · GPTs · Projects) to see it formatted for each platform.
output.tip: Each field has its own copy button, or use "Copy Everything" at the bottom.

meta.title: Orxis | Orchestrate AI with Strict Boundaries
meta.description: Orxis is a structured AI custom instruction generator. Define precise roles, cognitive loops, and output boundaries for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs.
